requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 构建一个智能孵化箱控制系统，使用 DHT11（D7）、加热器继电器 D10、风扇 D5、蜂鸣器 D6、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）、LED D13 和按钮 D2。系统需要维持温度在目标范围内并周期性通风；按钮可切换设定值查看模式和当前值显示模式。若温度连续 1 分钟高于上限或低于下限则报警并串口输出 incubation abnormal。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Set io_7=true and keep io_5=38.5 for many consecutive control steps (enough for the model abnormalHighCount threshold) with io_0=false.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: serial_0_trigger and serial_0_value_0 become true and io_2 (LED) becomes true; io_4 becomes 2000 (tone enable) and remains alarmed while alarmActive stays true.

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 构建一个智能孵化箱控制系统，使用 DHT11（D7）、加热器继电器 D10、风扇 D5、蜂鸣器 D6、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）、LED D13 和按钮 D2。系统需要维持温度在目标范围内并周期性通风；按钮可切换设定值查看模式和当前值显示模式。若温度连续 1 分钟高于上限或低于下限则报警并串口输出 incubation abnormal。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: With io_7=true and alarmActive false, drive a rising edge on io_0 (prevPressed=false then io_0=true) once; keep io_5 valid throughout.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: modeIsSetting toggles, and io_8 switches from displaying RealFunctions::floor(tempLastValid) to displaying RealFunctions::floor(targetTemp) on the step after the press.

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 构建一个智能孵化箱控制系统，使用 DHT11（D7）、加热器继电器 D10、风扇 D5、蜂鸣器 D6、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）、LED D13 和按钮 D2。系统需要维持温度在目标范围内并周期性通风；按钮可切换设定值查看模式和当前值显示模式。若温度连续 1 分钟高于上限或低于下限则报警并串口输出 incubation abnormal。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: With io_7=true, set io_5 below targetTemp (e.g., 36.0 when targetTemp=37.0) for one control step.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_1 (heater relay) becomes true when not alarmActive and io_7 is true and tempLastValid < targetTemp.

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 构建一个智能孵化箱控制系统，使用 DHT11（D7）、加热器继电器 D10、风扇 D5、蜂鸣器 D6、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）、LED D13 和按钮 D2。系统需要维持温度在目标范围内并周期性通风；按钮可切换设定值查看模式和当前值显示模式。若温度连续 1 分钟高于上限或低于下限则报警并串口输出 incubation abnormal。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Keep io_7=true and alarmActive false for multiple consecutive control steps with io_0=false; hold io_5 within nominal band (not >=38.0 and not <=36.0).
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_3 (fan control) toggles periodically (fanOn state alternates each control step when not alarmed), and io_3 is false when alarmActive is true.
